[b] Transmission for all the agents of the Kuskuscanta brotherhood.[/b]
The Kuskuscanta brotherhood a move it will make in the so said Vespuria empire, after it collapsed by an arcane form of said "magic", the fall of the order in the nation, we already sent a message for their imperial army , as much dirty the magnates are, we can receive a great amounts of reward by working for their army, we hope see you all there.
[i]Maíûchal, alone we fall, together we stand strong.
~The leader [REDACTED].[/i]
[b]Data sent to the imperial army:[/b]
A total of 46 agents will be sent, which we are afraid will be enough, however, if not proven enough more will be sent.
Equiped they are with rifles of the model CHM-4512, which specifications are:
Incendiary grenades.
5,56x45mm
Adjustable stock.
Systems taht prevent overheat.
[REDACTED]
Submachine guns for urban control.
Shields.
Also equiped with the Bracay-3 APCs, which are low profile armoured personal carrier vehicles, which can drive even on harsh mountainous places, equiped with a 25mm autocannon and 7,62mm mg.
Our tactics are furtive and guerrillas, taht is how we survived out of the Chimor radars for so long in fact.
This operation is not officially recognized by the Emperor nor the empire, the Brotherhood only wishes to try prevent the chaos which is currently attacking a fellow Vespurian neighbour so it will not arrive in our coasts nor mountains.
A message will be sent as we arrive on [redacted], worry not, our numbers can be sent more and more if wished, as long as the rewards remain, we prefer remain, discrete.
~Sincerely, brotherhood of Kuskuscanta.
.
Captain Wânkar looked to his army, a mob of about 2 dozens of soldiers equiped with rifles and wearing typical camouflaged suits.
"Do not forget."
The captain raised his rifle in hands.
"Do not run mad into whatever is in the Deeps of taht Sùpay land(Devil's land), we do not have any knowledge of what is inhabiting their cities anymore if is human or not, whatever these...things are..."
He takes a break.
"Just be wary... midnight is...scary."
The soldiers nooded in agreement, and then dispersed around the settlement, all of them were ex mitmas who choose the lives as mercenaries outlaw, the Brotherhood is the largest non recognized military private company of Chimor, and several are the ones who join it, the company having a unknown number of members, which are dispersed into many remote areas divided into small groups.
The captain adjusted his rifle on his waist, then looked at the sky for a moment, thoughtful he was.
[i]"I wonder how it will be...from rumours i heard the place seems a damn apocalypse, but, heh, i only believe if i see such 'hell'."[/i]
[/Spoiler][/quote]
